pages.text: $(bold)Mercury: The Burning World$()$(br)Mobs: $(bold){{dim ad_astra:mercury difficulty}}$() the vanilla strength, like every Tier 4 world$(br)Death penalty: $(bold){{dim ad_astra:mercury death}}$()$(br2)Mercury's day/night cycle is $(italic)lethal$(). The sun-facing side deals constant fire damage and the dark side extreme cold damage, so always know where the terminator line is.

$(bold)The Terminator Line$()$(br)The boundary between the sunlit and dark sides is the only place you can survive without full environmental protection. Follow it as the planet rotates.$(br2)$(bold)Day Side (Sun):$() constant fire damage. Heatward is essential.$(br)$(bold)Night Side (Dark):$() extreme cold damage. Frostward is essential.$(br2)Best of all, carry $(italic)both$() enchantments.

$(bold)Purpose$()$(br)Mercury has high-value heat-resistant ores and metals found only here, and they go into building the Tier 4 Rocket.$(br2)$(bold)Structures$()$(br)Ancient solar collection arrays and heat-sealed structures dot the surface, holding rare loot you can only get on Mercury.

$(bold)Planetary Rock Extraction$()$(br)Crush $(bold)Mercury Stone$() in Create Crushing Wheels or a Thermal Pulverizer to extract:$(br)• $(bold)Solar Crystal$() (20%): crystallized solar energy$(br)• $(bold)Rare Earth Dust$() (20%): high-tech crafting$(br)• Gold Nuggets (35%)$(br2)The Thermal Pulverizer gives slightly better odds.

$(bold)Stellar Shield Enchantment$()$(br)Mercury mobs have a $(bold)12% chance$() to drop an enchanted book of $(bold)Stellar Shield$() (max level 3). On armor, it:$(br)• Resists solar radiation$(br)• Reduces fire damage on planets by 33% per level$(br)• Negates Mercury's day-side fire damage at level 3$(br2)With Thermal Regulation, it covers all of Mercury.$(br2)$(bold)Next: farm both to level 3 for Venus.$()
